messages:
Priya: Quick heads up  prepping a compact QBR cost packet for Meridian. Need 60/90d spend, top token drivers, and a 1-page ops ask. Who can own each?
Lena: I can draft the one-pager and suggested customer wording.
Dan: Ill pull 60/90d token/day trend + scenario model (base / +25% campaign / -12% after optim). CSV by EOD.
Marta: Ill sample recent calls and tag heavy families. My guess: nightly embedding batches and long transcript TL;DRs.
Marco: I can own enablement demo (15min) on batching + prefix caching. Wed or Thu?
Priya: Wed 10am PT works. Marco lead demo, Marta cover mitigations, Dan bring numbers, Lena finalize one-pager.
Dan: Quick preview: MRR ~$10.2k, avg tokens/day ~900k, est monthly infer cost ~$2.8k. Scenario snippet: Base $2,800 / Campaign+25% $3,500 / Optimized-12% $2,464. Will upload CSV.
billing-bot: Forecast CSV uploaded: /team-shared/meridian/forecasts/3167778888.csv
Marta: Sample prompt families Im seeing:
- long-summarize: avg 18k tokens/call
- bulk-embed-nightly: avg 9k tokens/call
- multi-personalize: avg 6k tokens/call
Mitigations: schedule embeds midnight-6am, enable prefix caching, trim few-shot examples.
Priya: Set console alerts: +12% MTD and +28% absolute. Tag account owners.
quota-bot: Alert rules created. Use /quota request with one-pager for fast bump.
Marco: Will prep 15-min demo slides + 2 quick live examples (batching + cache).
Lena: Draft one-pager posted to #customer-docs as WIP. Includes asks: temp quota bump, 1 sprint for prompt trim, enablement session.
Priya: Final ask  capture two sample prompts customer will accept lower fidelity on during enablement. Add quick poll to the top of the deck.
Dan: Adding poll + peak-day monitor for next 48h. Will post any >20% day-over-day spikes.
Priya: Thanks team. If anything unexpected shows in the forecast, flag here and well escalate. :thumbsup:
